say:2:1029739001:0.text: Miss me? Your amazing Captain Sinbad returns, with a full haul, no less!
say:2:1029739001:0.source_cn: 好久不见了，朋友们！你们的伟大船长辛巴达再一次满载而归啦！

say:5:1029739003:0.text: That's right, darlings! It's me! How do you like my look? Stunning, right?
say:5:1029739003:0.source_cn: 没错，朋友们，就是我——我这身衣服怎么样，是不是非常漂亮？

say:6:1029739005:0.text: Anyway, drumroll please! Your glamorous host and her lovely friend have arrived!
say:6:1029739005:0.source_cn: 总之，各位，欢呼吧！你们了不起的主持人曼卡拉和她美丽的...

say:7:1029739006:0.text: Without waiting for your reply, Mikola sweeps dramatically through the crowd gathered at the docks.
say:7:1029739006:0.source_cn: 没有等你们回答，曼卡拉已经用她一如既往的张扬姿态在码头...

say:9:1029739007:0.text: To your surprise, her flair actually starts to draw cheers and applause...
say:9:1029739007:0.source_cn: 伴随着她的号召，周围居然真的开始逐渐响起了欢呼和叫好声……

say:10:1029739008:1.text: And before you stands another familiar figure—
say:10:1029739008:1.source_cn: 而在你们面前，出现的则是另一个身影——

say:13:1029739009:0.text: It's been a while, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you too, Chippy, Hammie.
say:13:1029739009:0.male: It's been a while, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you too, Chippy, Hammie.
say:13:1029739009:0.female: It's been a while, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you too, Chippy, Hammie.

choice_prompt:14:1029739009.text: It's been a while, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you too, Chippy, Hammie.
choice_prompt:14:1029739009.source_cn: 好久不见了，<style=stress><player_name></style>，还有满满和漫漫。
choice_prompt:14:1029739009.male: It's been a while, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you too, Chippy, Hammie.
choice_prompt:14:1029739009.female: It's been a while, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you too, Chippy, Hammie.

say:15:1029739010:0.text: Yes. It's been some time... What do you think of my outfit?
say:15:1029739010:0.source_cn: 嗯，梅林，好久不见了……我穿这身怎么样？
say:15:1029739010:0.male: Yes. It's been some time... What do you think of my outfit?
say:15:1029739010:0.female: Yes. It's been some time... What do you think of my outfit?

say:18:1029739013:1.text: Shh. I'm hiding my identity for now. Don't tell anyone I'm a Celestial, I'd like to enjoy this outfit just a little longer.
say:18:1029739013:1.source_cn: 嘘，我暂时隐瞒了身份，请不要告诉他们我是半神，我还想多...

say:19:1029739014:1.text: Alright... but why are you here with Mikola all of a sudden? Did something happen?
say:19:1029739014:1.source_cn: 好吧……那，塔琳，你怎么会突然来这边，还是和曼卡拉一起...

say:20:1029739015:1.text: I met Mikola near the Spirit Mound. She's incredibly cheerful and charming.
say:20:1029739015:1.source_cn: 简单来说，我与曼卡拉是在鹿灵圣丘那附近相遇的，她真是一...

say:21:1029739016:1.text: Oh! You want to hear how we met? Let me tell it!
say:21:1029739016:1.source_cn: 啊，在说我们认识的过程吗？我来说我来说！

say:22:1029739017:1.text: I took your wagon to Holistone for a little sightseeing, then hopped on a boat to the Dark Forest!
say:22:1029739017:1.source_cn: 之前我搭你们的车到圣石镇去玩了一下，然后就又坐船去了薄...

say:23:1029739018:1.text: The Wilders got so excited when they heard I was <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s friend!
say:23:1029739018:1.male: The Wilders got so excited when they heard I was <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s friend!
say:23:1029739018:1.female: The Wilders got so excited when they heard I was <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s friend!

say:24:1029739019:1.text: Anyway! I was visiting the Spirit Mound when I ran into dear Talene.
say:24:1029739019:1.source_cn: 总而言之！我在去鹿灵圣丘那边观光的时候，遇到了亲爱的塔琳！

say:25:1029739020:1.text: She looked so elegant and regal, I didn't even dare talk to her at first.
say:25:1029739020:1.source_cn: 不过她那时太端庄高贵了，我都有点不敢搭话，多亏——

say:26:1029739021:1.text: But thanks to a mutual friend's introduction, we finally got to talk.
say:26:1029739021:1.source_cn: 嗯，多亏了另一位女士的引见，我们才得以相识。

choice_prompt:27:1029739021.text: But thanks to a mutual friend's introduction, we finally got to talk.
choice_prompt:27:1029739021.source_cn: 嗯，多亏了另一位女士的引见，我们才得以相识。

say:28:1029739022:1.text: Yes. A graceful and capable lady. I'd seen her a few times while dealing with Hypogeans.
say:28:1029739022:1.source_cn: 是的，那是一位干练又美丽的女性，此前我遭遇恶魔的时候，...

say:29:1029739023:1.text: Her radiant feathers and beautiful voice always stood out to me, but I never had the chance to speak to her properly. Now I finally could.
say:29:1029739023:1.source_cn: 在那时，她那华丽的羽毛和清亮的鸣声就引起了我的注意，只...

say:30:1029739024:1.text: Wait... feathers? Beautiful voice? You don't mean—
say:30:1029739024:1.source_cn: 等等，羽毛？鸣声？你说的美丽女性，该不会是——

choice_prompt:31:1029739024.text: Wait... feathers? Beautiful voice? You don't mean—
choice_prompt:31:1029739024.source_cn: 等等，羽毛？鸣声？你说的美丽女性，该不会是——

say:32:1029739025:1.text: Yes, Elona. Even among the birds, her beauty and presence are unmatched.
say:32:1029739025:1.source_cn: 是的，正是艾洛娜，她的美貌与气质在诸多鸟儿当中也是数一...

say:33:1029739026:1.text: She's usually busy helping her partner, but this time, she had a rare break.
say:33:1029739026:1.source_cn: 她一直忙于协助她的伙伴工作，这次也是巧合之下，赶上了她...

say:34:1029739027:1.text: Haha, I can't tell one bird from another, but she did seem really pretty!
say:34:1029739027:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，虽然我是分辨不出来，但我觉得她确实是只很漂亮的鸟！

say:35:1029739028:1.text: Talene helped translate, and the three of us just clicked. We talked for hours! About work, dreams, friendship...
say:35:1029739028:1.source_cn: 塔琳还帮我们翻译，我们聊了好久呢，工作啦，事业啦，朋友啦——

say:36:1029739029:1.text: We may be different, but we really hit it off!
say:36:1029739029:1.source_cn: 我们虽然个性不一样，但真的特别特别特别合拍！

choice_prompt:37:1029739029.text: We may be different, but we really hit it off!
choice_prompt:37:1029739029.source_cn: 我们虽然个性不一样，但真的特别特别特别合拍！

say:38:1029739030:1.text: In any case, we bonded quickly on Spirit Mound and became fast friends.
say:38:1029739030:1.source_cn: 总之我们三人十分投契，在鹿灵圣丘相谈甚欢，成为了要好的朋友。

say:39:1029739031:1.text: To celebrate our new friendship, Mikola suggested we pick out matching outfits.
say:39:1029739031:1.source_cn: 为了纪念这份友情，在曼卡拉的提议下，我们决定挑些漂亮的...

say:40:1029739032:1.text: We chose this style because we heard you were enjoying a sunny beach getaway, <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:40:1029739032:1.male: We chose this style because we heard you were enjoying a sunny beach getaway, <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:40:1029739032:1.female: We chose this style because we heard you were enjoying a sunny beach getaway, <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:41:1029739033:0.text: So we thought why not surprise you in style?

say:45:1029739035:1.text: Unfortunately, no. These outfits are made for swimming, and there's no version for birds.
say:45:1029739035:1.source_cn: 是的，真遗憾，这种款式据说是适合游泳的服装，所以没有制...

say:46:1029739036:1.text: Birds that can swim don't need them, and the ones that don't... well, they're not going in the water anyway, so I guess that's why it doesn't exist.
say:46:1029739036:1.source_cn: 毕竟会游泳的鸟儿应该用不上，而不会游泳的鸟儿也不能下水...

say:48:1029739037:1.text: Talene... really lacks common sense in some areas.
say:48:1029739037:1.source_cn: 塔琳……在某些方面会格外缺乏常识啊。

say:49:1029739038:1.text: Anyway, since Elona couldn't come with us to see you, we decided on an alternative.
say:49:1029739038:1.source_cn: 不过，考虑到艾洛娜本来也要工作，无法和我与曼卡拉一起来...

say:50:1029739039:1.text: We found a men's swimsuit at a stall nearby and bought it for her partner—as a token of our friendship!
say:50:1029739039:1.source_cn: 嗯嗯，正好摊位上有男装，我们就给她的伙伴买了一身，就当...

say:51:1029739040:1.text: Elona said she'd deliver it. Even if we're apart, our friendship stays strong!

say:53:1029739041:0.source_cn: ……布莱恩……穿这种花团锦簇的泳装会是什么样子呢……有...

say:54:1029739042:1.source_cn: 正当此时，一个愉快的声音响了起来。

say:57:1029739043:1.text: No need for that! If you want to meet again, just hop aboard my ship next time. I'll bring your friends here myself!
say:57:1029739043:1.source_cn: 那算什么，你们要想见面，下次就坐我的船，我把你的朋友们...

say:58:1029739044:1.text: Great idea! Let us know when you're heading to Holistone. We'll go pick them up together!
say:58:1029739044:1.source_cn: 好主意！那你下次出发到圣石镇时记得通知我们，我们一起去...

say:59:1029739045:1.text: But for now... Talene, let's explore the city and find some fun souvenirs!
say:59:1029739045:1.source_cn: 至于现在这段时间……塔琳，我们就在城里好好逛逛，买点礼...
